name: 01_system_context

purpose: Distinguish reference evidence, future site sources and human authority.

purpose: Show the fictional current process and where advisory evidence would enter.

purpose: Preserve authorized source bytes, promote validated bearing/run records and publish versioned features and advisory products with lineage.

name: 04_model_lifecycle

purpose: Trace qualified signals through leakage-safe preparation, candidate evaluation and versioned registration; registration does not authorize release.

purpose: Bind scoring to the released preprocessing/model/policy versions, preserve abstention and human authority, and route change signals to reviewed revalidation.

name: 05_human_decision
title: Advisory Policy and Human Decisions
purpose: Model output cannot bypass eligibility or customer approval.

name: 06_security_boundaries

purpose: Separate future plant collection, processing and restricted evidence access.

name: 07_deployment_candidate

purpose: Separate reference development, release validation and later site deployment; show storage, compute, model assets and operational evidence without binding resources.

purpose: Distinguish private inbound client access from managed compute egress and identity authorization; resource placement is logical, not an implemented network.

name: 08_release_gates

purpose: Bind each promotion to verified artifacts, an exact destination, current evidence and release authority; failures deny new exposure.

name: 08b_rollback_recovery

name: 09_operations_recovery

purpose: Connect runtime signals to accountable human response and revalidation.

name: 10_traceability
